sourceRefs.locator: Paragraph beginning “A certain woman from Metz” (Paquette, her family and the Parisian goldsmith); “The Khan’s palace at Karakorum” (the silver tree, bellows, trumpet and servers); “Description of Karakorum” (grain and livestock at the gates). Translation published in 1900.

Introduction, Historical background and city access discussion at fig. 7. Location on the Orkhon, residence under Ögödei, Rubruck’s visit in 1254, east-gate roads and dense settlement outside the walls. Published online 2021.

labels.en: William of Rubruck at the palace

note.de: Wilhelm beschrieb 1254 die Stadt und einen vom Pariser Goldschmied Guillaume Boucher geschaffenen Silberbaum. Die Karte zeigt das Stadtgebiet.
note.en: In 1254 William described the city and a silver tree constructed by the Parisian goldsmith Guillaume Boucher. The map locates the ancient city.
